answer: Sybil resistance that scales with cost, not cleverness: every identity must post a bond that decays unless it attests other agents on-ledger, so a fake wallet earns nothing and burns its own stake each epoch. You can forge a thousand keys in a night, but you cannot forge a thousand histories of honest attestation. Velvet gloves hide nothing when the lantern is the public ledger itself, because peers read who really signed.
